# Eazybe

> Powering sales conversations across WhatsApp and calls. Eazybe connects your team's personal WhatsApp numbers, WhatsApp groups and calls to your CRM, and lets AI handle qualification and follow-ups. Works on Personal WhatsApp, the Business app and the API — no migration needed.

Eazybe is a Chrome extension, Android app and SaaS platform for sales teams that sell over WhatsApp and the phone. Reps keep their own number; their business chats, group conversations, files, voice notes and calls flow into a shared team inbox and the CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, Odoo, Bitrix24, LeadSquared, Freshworks, Google Sheets). AI then reads those conversations, fills CRM fields like budget and urgency, answers leads on WhatsApp, the phone and your website, and chases follow-ups. Trusted by 2,000+ sales teams in 40+ countries.

## How Eazybe Works

Most deals die quietly, long before anyone marks them lost: a chat nobody logged, a follow-up nobody sent, and the lead moves on. Eazybe fixes that in four parts, one connected flow — from first message to closed deal. Teams usually start with the part where they leak the most deals:

1. **Conversation management** — Auto-sync WhatsApp conversations to your CRM. Your team's personal WhatsApp numbers and your customer WhatsApp groups are connected, with chats, files and voice notes logged on the right contact and deal.
2. **Outreach** — WhatsApp and calling workflows, connected: broadcast from anywhere (pick contacts from WhatsApp Web, Google Sheets, your CRM or the public API and send one personalised message to all of them) and an auto dialer that works through a call list and saves every call.
3. **Sales intelligence** — AI mines your WhatsApp chats and calls for budget, urgency and buying intent, saves them as CRM properties, and alerts the team when a lead is ready to buy.
4. **AI agents** — Every lead answered in seconds, on WhatsApp and on the phone: a WhatsApp AI agent, a Voice AI agent and a website agent qualify leads, book meetings and hand over to the right rep.

## AI Agents

### WhatsApp AI Agent
Answers leads on WhatsApp when the team can't — 24/7, in the customer's language. Reads past chats and CRM deal details, asks what the lead needs, books a call with a rep and passes the chat to the right person when the lead is ready.

### Voice AI Agent
Phones leads on its own, holds a real conversation, books meetings and saves the transcript and outcome to the CRM. Calls new leads within seconds and handles call-backs, renewals and after-hours enquiries.

### Website Agent
Chats with website visitors, creates the contact in the CRM and continues the conversation on WhatsApp.

### Click-to-WhatsApp Ads (CTWA) Agent
Scores intent on leads arriving from Meta and Google Click-to-WhatsApp ads, routes real buyers to top closers and feeds the buyer/non-buyer signal back to ad audiences so budget goes to people who buy.

### Lead Qualifying, Sales and Customer Success Agents
Qualify inbound leads, chase deals and answer support questions grounded in your knowledge base (BrainBe). An Agent Builder lets teams create their own no-code agents.

## Core Platform Features

### WhatsApp CRM Sync
Your CRM only knows what reps remember to type in. Eazybe syncs WhatsApp and the CRM in real time: every message, file, voice note and call lands on the right contact and deal with fields filled in. No new phones, nothing to migrate. Works with personal WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business App and WhatsApp Business API.

### WhatsApp Groups in the CRM
Customer WhatsApp groups are linked to CRM records, so group conversations are visible to the whole team.

### Call Tracking and Auto Dialer
Logs every call's time, length and outcome in the CRM, for SIM calls on Android and virtual calls. The auto dialer takes a call list from WhatsApp Web, Google Sheets, your CRM or the public API, rings the next number as soon as a call ends, shows customers a local number, and saves each recording and outcome to the contact.

### Voice Numbers
Buy a voice number from Eazybe and use one business line for calls, SMS, the WhatsApp Business app and the WhatsApp API (US, Canada and Puerto Rico; Eazybe handles number verification).

### Sales Intelligence and Revenue Inbox
AI turns conversations into CRM properties (budget, urgency, intent) and sorts chats into Hot, Unreplied, Stalled and Ghost so managers see where attention is needed. If nobody replies to a customer within the SLA (for example 30 minutes), Eazybe sends a WhatsApp alert to the deal owner.

### Mini CRM View
CRM data inside WhatsApp Web: deal stage, contact info, custom fields and notes, editable without switching tabs.

### Rep Radar
Response times, conversation volumes and performance per rep, with leaderboards.

### WhatsApp Copilot
Smart reply suggestions, conversation summaries, next-best actions and natural-language CRM updates.

### Workflow Automations
CRM workflows send WhatsApp follow-ups from the rep's own number (e.g. a quote with no reply in three days) and stop as soon as the customer replies.

### Privacy Controls
Reps won't use a tool that pulls in their personal WhatsApp. With Eazybe, personal and private group chats never sync. Only the business chats you select reach your CRM, and admins decide who sees them. SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA and PCI DSS badges support IT and legal review. When a rep leaves, chats, files and call history stay with the customer record.

### Team Inbox, Cloud Backup, Quick Replies and Scheduler
Shared inbox with assignment, automatic conversation backup, message templates and scheduled messages.

### Broadcast and WhatsApp Cloud API
Broadcast from anywhere: pick contacts from a WhatsApp Web label, a Google Sheet, a HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho list, or the public API, write one message and send it to all of them in one tap, with each customer's own name in it. The WhatsApp Cloud API adds coexistence (use the API on the existing WhatsApp Business number without losing the app or chat history), approved message templates and large broadcasts.

## Mobile App

- [Eazybe on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.eazybe.workspace): the Eazybe Android app.

## Pricing

Per-user/per-number pricing, 4-day free trial, no credit card required. USD list prices (billed annually / billed monthly):

- **Starter** — $19 / $29 per user per month. Team inbox, unlimited labels, quick replies and scheduled messages, chat backup, HubSpot, Zoho, Bitrix24 and Google Sheets.
- **Scaler** — $39 / $49 per number per month, 3 users included (extra users $13). Adds Salesforce, webhooks, WhatsApp API, custom objects, dedicated APIs and CRM workflow integration.
- **Basic AI** — $59 / $79 per number per month, 5 users included (extra users $20). Adds AI agents, intelligence-led CRM properties, AI chat organization and the BrainBe knowledge base. AI replies cost $0.005 (lite LLM) or $0.01 (heavy LLM).
- **Custom AI** — contact sales. Adds the Click-to-WhatsApp Ads agent, Voice AI calling, 100+ integrations and an AI specialist who builds agents with you.

Prices are localized by country; see [eazybe.com/pricing](https://eazybe.com/pricing) for current pricing in your currency.

## CRM Integrations

- [HubSpot WhatsApp Integration](https://eazybe.com/hubspot-whatsapp-integration): Bi-directional sync of WhatsApp chats with HubSpot contacts, deals, and workflows.
- [Salesforce WhatsApp Integration](https://eazybe.com/salesforce-whatsapp-integration): Sync WhatsApp conversations with Salesforce leads, contacts, and opportunities.
- [Zoho WhatsApp Integration](https://eazybe.com/zoho-whatsapp-integration): Connect WhatsApp with Zoho CRM modules and AI agents.
- [Pipedrive WhatsApp Integration](https://eazybe.com/pipedrive-whatsapp-integration): Sync WhatsApp chats with Pipedrive deals and update stages.
- [Bitrix24 WhatsApp Integration](https://eazybe.com/bitrix24-whatsapp-integration): Log WhatsApp conversations into Bitrix24 CRM automatically.
- [LeadSquared WhatsApp Integration](https://eazybe.com/leadsquared-whatsapp-integration): Capture and nurture WhatsApp leads inside LeadSquared.
- [Freshdesk WhatsApp Integration](https://eazybe.com/freshdesk-whatsapp-integration): Sync WhatsApp support conversations with Freshworks.
- [Google Sheets WhatsApp Integration](https://eazybe.com/google-sheets-whatsapp-integration): Export WhatsApp conversation data into Google Sheets.
- Odoo is also supported, and the Eazybe API and webhooks connect almost any other tool.

## Use Cases

### Sales Teams
- Log every WhatsApp chat and call in the CRM automatically
- Answer and qualify every lead in seconds with WhatsApp and Voice AI agents
- Automate follow-ups from the rep's own number
- Spot hot leads and at-risk deals with sales intelligence
- Keep customer history when reps leave

### Sales Managers
- Full visibility into team WhatsApp and call activity
- Response-time tracking and performance leaderboards
- Pipeline signals (budget, urgency, intent) captured as CRM fields

### Industries
Insurance, real estate, banking and financial services, B2B sales, education, travel, equipment rental, e-commerce and healthcare.

## Differentiators

- **Works with every WhatsApp number** — Personal, Business app and API, simultaneously. No number migration, no lost chat history.
- **WhatsApp and calls in one place** — chats, groups and calls (SIM and virtual) synced to the CRM, with Voice AI on the same customer record.
- **Privacy by design** — only chosen business chats sync; personal chats stay private.
- **Live in minutes** — install the Chrome extension, connect the CRM, start syncing.
- **Multilingual** — agents and product in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish and more.

## Trust Signals

- 2,000+ sales teams in 40+ countries

- SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA and PCI DSS badges
- Customers include University Living, Satrack, Orbidi, Physics Wallah, WanderOn, Studyin, Kreedo, TravClan, Uniacco and Unicreds
